title: Build Reviewable FTC Tutorial Exemplar
summary: Implement the accepted tutorial core and prove synchronized symbolic reasoning, finite-strip convergence, accumulated-area geometry, a movable bound, cross-view correspondence, interpretive cycles, shared-clock playback, accessibility, and export through a reviewable FTC module; stop before gold promotion.

sourceRefs.summary: FTC exemplar behavior and exit conditions.

verification: Interaction, rewind, accessibility, performance, and export browser gates
expectedLearning: Whether the tutorial kernel explains reasoning across symbols and graphs without renderer-owned timing.
disallowedWork: No gold promotion, cross-domain generalization, arbitrary function entry, voice synthesis, learner modeling, gamification, or universal scene infrastructure before human review.
